decisions.implementation: Add frappe-direct-python-eval-exec; keep safe evaluators and dynamic dispatch as distinct audit questions.
Add frappe-dynamic-template-with-default-globals and exclude literal paths, is_path rendering and explicitly restricted globals from that claim.
Keep the immutable backport as a shell-sink inventory; do not infer injection without dynamic command evidence.
Keep the immutable upstream compatibility warning outside blocking enforcement; current findings are framework tests.
Add frappe-ignored-permission-result with nested-assignment exclusions so only discarded booleans match.
